subject: cotton sprout moon lander
title: What If You Planted a Seed on the Moon? China Did in 2019. It Lived 9 Days

scenes.text: What if you planted a seed on the Moon? China did. It lived nine days.
January 3rd, 2019: the Chang'e 4 lander touched down on the far side, carrying a sealed canister of soil, water and air, with cotton, rapeseed and potato seeds, yeast and fruit fly eggs.
Within days, a cotton seed sprouted. The first plant ever to grow on another world.
Then the lunar night came: two weeks of darkness. The canister had no heater, and inside it the temperature fell to minus 52 Celsius.
The experiment ran about 212 hours, nine days, and ended with a single dead seedling frozen in a box on the Moon.
But the leaf had opened. Nine days on the Moon is still nine days longer than anything else has ever grown out there.

description:
What if you planted a seed on the Moon? China's Chang'e 4 mission did it in January 2019, and a cotton seedling became the first plant to grow on another world.
The lander touched down on the far side on 3 January 2019 carrying a sealed biosphere canister from Chongqing University with cotton, oilseed rape, potato and Arabidopsis seeds, yeast and fruit fly eggs. A cotton seed sprouted within days, but when the two-week lunar night arrived the unheated canister dropped to about minus 52 Celsius and the seedling died. The experiment ran about 212 hours, roughly nine days.
